channel.title: Call by Reference vs. Value :: CC 210 Textbook
channel.description: Video Materials As we start creating objects, one major concept is how objects are handled differently than “primitive” data types when used as arguments; i.e. when passed to functions. Typically, there are two scenarios: call by value and call by reference. Let’s discuss them both in detail to understand how they differ and the impact that may have on our code.
